exposure: Mode of delivery (spontaneous vaginal delivery, cesarean section)
cohort: 304 twin pregnancies at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology of Demokrition University of Thrace in Alexandroupolis, Greece over a 15-year period
finding: The study found an increasing trend of twin pregnancies and births, with a high rate of cesarean deliveries (95.5%).
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rate was 95.5%, with only ten cases of successful spontaneous vaginal delivery, which occurred at a mean gestational age of 37.37 weeks with both fetuses in cephalic presentation.
